speaker: Osono
text: Hello Larry! Fancy a little tea break together?

speaker: Larry
text: Ah, Osono. Yes, actually. Quiet moment sounds rather nice.

speaker: Osono
text: I was imagining the most wonderful warm bread. Crusty outside, soft inside.

speaker: Larry
text: That does sound rather comforting. Better than my pretend stack of reports.

speaker: Osono
text: We could play hide and seek in an imaginary bakery! You hide the bread rolls?

speaker: Larry
text: I rather like that idea. Though I might need a nap first, truthfully.

speaker: Osono
text: Oh, a good nap before adventures is perfectly sensible. Very organized of you.

speaker: Larry
text: Indeed. Then we shall find those rolls together. Sounds rather lovely, really.
